known_limits: General Supabase software releases still use the historical fixture delegation; no general MCP-driven source-to-production release is certified.
Source delivery is bounded UTF-8 noncredential text, at most 8 MiB and 64 KiB per range; binary delivery is not implemented.
GitHub PR writes, Actions, repository administration, binary artifacts and remaining wildcard constituents are not certified by these tests.
Git ref deletion remains outside routine delegation until source-preserving recovery exists.
An uncertain consumed provider mutation is not automatically replayed; unadmitted inverse delivery resumes only under the same bound nonce.
The separate intelligence release still pins engineering-runtime v14 and must reconcile the live v15 baseline before rollout.
